description: A pneumatic tube system is an engineering solution for the automatic delivery of documents, cash, lab samples, keys and other items weighing up to 1 kg. Capsules travel through pipelines at up to 8 m/s over distances of up to 600 metres.
where: banks and financial institutions, supermarkets and retail chains, hospitals and laboratories, industrial enterprises, multi-floor office buildings.
advantages: Instant delivery of documents, cash and small items up to 1 kg
Speed up to 8 m/s — faster than any courier
Fully automated routing — zero manual intervention
Real-time shipment tracking on LCD displays
Software control with integration into corporate systems
Minimal maintenance — designed for years of reliable operation
High security — password-protected stations and data encryption
Suitable for new builds and renovation of existing premises
